content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I hope you’re well.

- The agreement currently states: "Contractor will accommodate reasonable changes to scope requested by Client within the overall project budget. Changes that would exceed that budget are documented in a written change request." This would require the contractor to accept scope changes that stay within the budget at no extra compensation, exposing you to unpaid extra work. I propose to change the clause to: "Contractor shall not be required to accommodate scope changes without a mutually agreed written change order specifying any additional compensation."

- The agreement currently states: "The parties intend to allow 15 rounds of ordinary revisions for the principal creative Deliverables. Additional revisions may require a written change order." Allowing up to 15 revision rounds is far more than typical and could increase workload without extra pay. I propose to limit revisions to 4 rounds per Deliverable, with any additional revisions requiring a written change order and may be billed separately.

- The agreement currently states: "Invoices are payable Net 60." This payment term delays cash flow and increases credit risk. I propose to set payment terms to Net 30.

- The agreement currently states: "Revision allowance: 15 rounds". This permits up to 15 revision rounds, which may force many extra iterations without extra pay. I propose to limit the revision allowance to up to 3 rounds.

- The agreement currently states: "Payment period: Net 60". This would delay cash flow beyond the usual 30‑day window. I propose to change the payment period to Net 30.

Thank you for considering these adjustments. I look forward to finalising the agreement.
